risks.risk: docs/codex/02_PHASES.md documents the parent P13/P14 phases but not the P13O subphase loop.
risks.notes: docs/codex/05_P13_OPTIMIZATION_LOOP.md documents P13O-04 and the P13O execution rules; the P13O manifest provides the authoritative gates for this audit.

rationale: All P13O-04 manifest gates passed with command text and log SHA256 values matching the manifest and gate result. Required artifacts exist and validate against repository schemas. Real Valkey evidence is not required for this phase, and the parent P13 scale_50 and scale_100 real gate commands remain scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py wrapper gates. The relevant diff marks existing slow tests and defines explicit markers without deleting tests or introducing host network, firewall, sudo, P14, or default >100-node behavior.
